Summary: Close the AI Guru credit self-grant bypass
Description:
CONTEXT: supabase/migrations/20240101000034_guru_ai_weekly_credits.sql defines sync_guru_ai_tier_to_profile(p_tier), grant_guru_ai_purchased_credits(p_amount), and consume_guru_ai_credit() as SECURITY DEFINER functions GRANTed to 'authenticated' with no check against an actual RevenueCat entitlement. Any authenticated user can call these directly and grant themselves Pro-tier AI credits for free, bypassing RevenueCat entirely. HIGHEST-IMPACT FIX IN THE BACKLOG.
DESIGN APPROACH (pick one, document the choice): Option A (recommended) -- Edge Function receiving RevenueCat webhooks, verified signature, sole caller of the two grant functions (service role key), REVOKE EXECUTE from authenticated. Option B (faster, weaker) -- keep client-callable but require a receipt/transaction id verified server-side via RevenueCat REST API before applying.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- REVOKE EXECUTE on sync_guru_ai_tier_to_profile and grant_guru_ai_purchased_credits FROM authenticated
- Edge Function (or receipt-verification RPC) performs the grant only after confirming entitlement in RevenueCat
- consume_guru_ai_credit() remains callable by authenticated but reviewed against going negative / bypassing weekly cap
- lib/features/ai_guru/services/guru_ai_credits_service.dart and lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/spiritual_chat_screen.dart (~lines 87, 399) updated to call the new secured path
- Manual test: calling sync_guru_ai_tier_to_profile('pro') with only an authenticated JWT (no purchase) fails
VERIFY: Scripted test with free-tier JWT and no purchase -- rejected. Real (sandbox) RevenueCat purchase still results in correct tier applied end to end.
PARALLEL-SAFE WITH: AM-8, AM-9, AM-10. BLOCKS: AM-16.
